## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky23

- Fix dictionary concatenation in `select()` expressions when the dictionaries use different representations, including compact frozen dictionaries. Backports upstream [ffeda605099d](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/ffeda605099df0e29bee0398640fb97fd295b0f2).
- Restore inherited Starlark methods hidden by the dictionary subclass changes, including `ctx.var.items()`, `.keys()`, and `.values()` when configuration-fragment tracking is enabled. Backports upstream [6eb86cd3964b](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/6eb86cd3964b7f3dee44f37ba06536cf48208b59).

Both fixes address regressions introduced by the memory optimizations in release 23. The followup audit found no other missing correctness fix required by those optimizations. This release adds no new memory optimizations.

### Validation

Six regression tests reproduced the selector and missing-method failures against the release 23 implementations. All six are included in the passing suites with the fixes, covering mixed compact/map-backed dictionaries and `ctx.var.items()` accessed-key tracking.

All 23 targeted test targets passed on Linux x86_64 with remote execution: the 22 targets used for release 23 plus `RequiredConfigFragmentsTest`. These cover Starlark evaluation and syntax, selectors, providers and serialization, configuration tracking, rule attributes, Skyframe, actions, C++ headers, `ijar`, and ZIP handling.

### Release publication

This release is immutable and includes Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
